Name: DE-Estimates
Statement:
-- +ASSIGNMENTS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Estimate)
-- +CUSTOMFIELDS(Skill.Module.BusinessObjects.Estimate)
with
tag as
(
    select  Oid as EstimateId,
            string_agg(tag.Label, ', ') as Tags
    from    Estimate
                cross apply openjson(TagsJson) with (Label nvarchar(255) '$.Label') as tag
    group by Oid
),
t as
(
    select  tt.Estimate,
            sum(tt.BilledWithoutVat) as BilledWithoutVat,
            sum(tt.CreditedWithoutVat) as CreditedWithoutVat,
            sum(tt.CreditedWithVat) as CreditedWithVat,
            sum(tt.EstimatedIncomeWithoutVat) as EstimatedIncomeWithoutVat,
            sum(tt.EstimatedIncomeWithVat) as EstimatedIncomeWithVat,
            sum(tt.EstimatedCostWithoutVat) as EstimatedCostWithoutVat,
            sum(tt.EstimatedCostWithVat) as EstimatedCostWithVat,
            sum(tt.EstimatedIncomeWithVatApproved) as EstimatedIncomeWithVatApproved,
            sum(tt.EstimatedCostWithVatSupplier) as EstimatedCostWithVatSupplier,
            sum(tt.EstimatedIncomeWithVatApproved - tt.EstimatedCostWithVatSupplier) as EstimatedRevenueWithVat
    from
    (
        select  est.Oid as Estimate,
                sum(bil.ValueWithoutVat) as BilledWithoutVat,
                0 as CreditedWithoutVat,
                0 as CreditedWithVat,
                0 as EstimatedIncomeWithoutVat,
                0 as EstimatedIncomeWithVat,
                0 as EstimatedCostWithoutVat,
                0 as EstimatedCostWithVat,
                0 as EstimatedIncomeWithVatApproved,
                0 as EstimatedCostWithVatSupplier
        from    Bill bil,
                Estimate est,
                WorkflowState wks,
                WorkflowStateType wst
        where   est.Oid = bil.Estimate and
                wks.Oid = bil.WorkflowState and
                wst.Oid = wks.WorkflowStateType and
                wst.Status != 7 and
                bil.[External] is not null
        group by est.Oid
        union all
        select  est.Oid as Estimate,
                0 as BilledWithoutVat,
                sum(cre.ValueWithoutVat) as CreditedWithoutVat,
                sum(cre.ValueWithVat) as CreditedWithVat,
                0 as EstimatedIncomeWithoutVat,
                0 as EstimatedIncomeWithVat,
                0 as EstimatedCostWithoutVat,
                0 as EstimatedCostWithVat,
                0 as EstimatedIncomeWithVatApproved,
                0 as EstimatedCostWithVatSupplier
        from    ClientCreditNote cre,
                Bill bil,
                Estimate est,
                WorkflowState wks,
                WorkflowStateType wst
        where   est.Oid = bil.Estimate and
                cre.Bill = bil.Oid and
                wks.Oid = cre.WorkflowState and
                wst.Oid = wks.WorkflowStateType and
                wst.Status != 7 and
                cre.[External] is not null
        group by est.Oid
        union all
        select  est.Oid as Estimate,
                0 as BilledWithoutVat,
                0 as CreditedWithoutVat,
                0 as CreditedWithVat,
                sum(eid.ValueWithoutVatIncome * est.Exchange * eit.Retainer) as EstimatedIncomeWithoutVat,
                sum(eid.ValueWithVatIncome * est.Exchange * eit.Retainer) as EstimatedIncomeWithVat,
                sum(eid.ValueWithoutVatCost * est.Exchange * eit.Retainer) as EstimatedCostWithoutVat,
                sum(eid.ValueWithVatCost * est.Exchange * eit.Retainer) as EstimatedCostWithVat,
                sum(iif(eit.Approved = 1, eid.ValueWithVatIncome * est.Exchange * eit.Retainer, 0)) as EstimatedIncomeWithVatApproved,
                sum(iif(eid.SupplierCost is not null, eid.ValueWithoutVatCost * est.Exchange * eit.Retainer, 0)) as EstimatedCostWithVatSupplier
        from    Estimate est,
                EstimateItem eit,
                EstimateItemDetail eid,
                WorkflowState wks,
                WorkflowStateType wst
        where   eit.Estimate = est.Oid and
                eid.EstimateItem = eit.Oid and
                wks.Oid = est.WorkflowState and
                wst.Oid = wks.WorkflowStateType and
                wst.Status not in (6, 7)
        group by est.Oid
    ) tt
    group by tt.Estimate
)
select  est.Oid,
        est.Oid as DocumentOid,
        est.Oid as EstimateId,
        est.Number + ' - ' + est.Name as Estimate,
        est.Number as EstimateNumber,
        dep.Id as DepartmentId,
        dep.Name as Department,
        est.ModifiedOnUtc as ModifiedOn,
        wfs.Oid as StageId,
        wfs.Name as Stage,
        wst.Status as StageTypeId,
        wst.Name as StageType,
        typ.Oid as TypeId,
        typ.Name as Type,
        est.Client as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        cnt.Id as ContractId,
        cnt.Number + ' - ' + cnt.Name as Contract,
        est.Project as ProjectId,
        prj.Number + ' - ' + prj.Name as Project,
        job.Id as JobId,
        job.NameAndExternalId as Job,
        brd.Oid as BrandId,
        brd.Name as Brand,
        pro.Oid as ProductId,
        pro.Name as Product,
        est.Currency as CurrencyId,
        cur.Name as Currency,
        est.Exchange as Exchange,
        est.Date as StartDate,
        est.Expiration as EndDate,
        rtc.Oid as RateCardId,
        rtc.Name as RateCard,
        rcc.Oid as RateCardColumnId,
        rcc.Name as RateCardColumn,
        tag.Tags,
        t.EstimatedCostWithoutVat as ValueWithoutTaxCost,
        t.EstimatedCostWithVat - t.EstimatedCostWithoutVat as TaxValueCost,
        t.EstimatedCostWithVat as ValueWithTaxCost,
        t.EstimatedIncomeWithoutVat as ValueWithoutTaxSell,
        t.EstimatedIncomeWithVat - t.EstimatedIncomeWithoutVat as TaxValueSell,
        t.EstimatedIncomeWithVat as ValueWithTaxSell,
        t.BilledWithoutVat as BilledWithoutTax,
        t.CreditedWithoutVat as CreditedWithoutTax,
        t.CreditedWithVat as CreditedWithTax,
        t.EstimatedRevenueWithVat as RevenueWithTax
from    Estimate est
            left join JobType typ on typ.Oid = est.JobType
            join WorkflowState wfs on wfs.Oid = est.WorkflowState
            join WorkflowStateType wst on wst.Oid = wfs.WorkflowStateType
            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = est.Client
            left join ProjectLookup prj on prj.Id = est.Project
            left join ContractLookup cnt on cnt.Id = est.Contract
            left join JobLookup job on job.Id = est.Deliverable
            left join CommercialClientProduct pro on pro.Oid = est.Product
            left join Brand brd on brd.Oid = pro.Brand
            left join Currency cur on cur.Oid = est.Currency
            left join RateCard rtc on rtc.Oid = est.RateCard
            left join RateCardColumn rcc on rcc.Oid = est.RateCardColumn
            join DepartmentLookup dep on dep.Id = est.Department
            left join tag on tag.EstimateId = est.Oid
            left join t on t.Estimate = est.Oid
